purpose: Teach: 桐/天狗/ダニ/シティー/飛び込み/海水浴/リハビリテーション/ヘビ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、桐の箪笥あんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, your family has a paulownia chest, right?
lines.style: Casual, knowing tease. Light lilt on the question mark—she's testing whether he knows where this is going. Friendly but with a sharp edge underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、天狗の伝説好きだろ、桜
lines.en: You like tengu legends, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a counter-question. Slightly guarded—he's noticed her pattern and is turning it back on her. Steady, no smile in his voice yet.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ダニアレルギーだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you have a dust mite allergy, right?
lines.style: Direct hit. Slight pause before the question, like she's laying down evidence. Confident in her knowledge. Watching for his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族でシティーホテル泊まったろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't your family stay at a city hotel, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet turnabout. Gentle counter-attack—he's building his case carefully. Calm, methodical, almost clinical in tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、プールの飛び込み台怖がってたな
lines.en: You were scared of the diving platform at the pool, remember?
lines.style: Wry, pointed. Slight smirk in her voice. She's layering on the observations now—confident she's winning. Quick, sharp delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏休みに海水浴行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to the beach for summer break, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Building momentum. Less deflecting now—he's found his rhythm. Steady, matter-of-fact. Almost resigned to where this is heading.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、リハビリテーションのボランティアやってんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you volunteer for rehabilitation work, don't you?
lines.style: Triumphant final point. Delivered with quiet satisfaction—she's made her connection and knows it. Holds the moment. No rush.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ヘビが苦手だろ、桜
lines.en: You're scared of snakes, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Checkmate. Quiet, almost gentle closure. He's matched her move for move and found the last piece. Steady eye-contact level. Small exhale at the end—case closed.
